summary: 本次为对 review_artifacts/runtime_self_test_verification_code_design.md（sha256 a7a6c767…f767d8）这一份 exact 候选的最终独立外部内容审查。逐条重评 18 项完成要求后，全部判定为 satisfied，findings 为空。候选把 T2 11 的 42 项 capability inventory、focused/complete 语义、Runtime 临时测试资源租约、Reviewer repository/command 会话与 persistent/durable/live-provider gates 固定为一份可实现合同：primary flow 先于实现细节且 12 条边全部解析（9 条 interface、3 条 error），9 个 interface 与 10 个 error identity 唯一并各自声明 declared/referenced 与 semantic owner，三个 Slice 的 required_tests 恰为其所辖模块测试集的并集（20/36/12），被排除面全部落入唯一后继 slice 的 deferred_integrations 并附完成门，公共投影与前身移除明确交给 plan step 7/10，live transport 证据交给 step 12，绑定解析交给 step 11。两份 shard 报告合计提出的五项缺陷（Execution helper 输入缺少 registry、架构错误集合“五/六”计数矛盾、step 9 slice 内含 live transport 测试、module_registration 的 schema version 表述、未冻结 conformance_architecture_validation.py）经逐条比对，在本 exact 候选中均已不存在：见第 145 行与 563-564 行的 lease registry 传递、第 603 与 611 行一致的“six strings/all six errors”、第 342/445/588-591 行改为确定性 validator/classification 测试、第 551-552 行的 runtime_module_registration_v2 与 @v4 schema refs、第 716 行已冻结的校验器源。code-truth shard 自述的 subject hash 为 6efd74ef…，与本次供给的 a7a6c767… 不同，说明其审查对象为更早修订版，故其结论按证据而非既有裁决处理。本次无工具，未能重算 step-row hash、冻结源表哈希、Charter/08/09 设计哈希及架构错误字符串，相关限制列于 scope_notes。本结论只是外部内容审查，不构成批准、注册、suite 准入、release 准入或 exact-commit Engineering Review。

scope_notes: External content review of the supplied candidate bytes only. This is not approval, not registered Runtime review, not exact-commit Engineering Review, not suite admission and not release admission; no file was edited and no implementation, registration or delivery permission is expressed or implied.

No tools were available. Evaluation used the candidate text and the supplied read-only excerpts only; regions of the plan, T2 11, T2 05 and the_software_delivery outside those excerpts, and the Execution/Invocation bases, were not resolved.

Hash values verified directly against supplied FULL_SOURCE_SHA256 values: the plan hash cf0305be…a2b576 (line 696), T2 11 096ee22c…6bf01e (line 39) and T2 05 5cc5ea90…dca323 (lines 55, 505). Not independently recomputable here: the step-row hash 34859441… (line 59), the Charter 243a821d…, T2 08 66a7d20f…, T2 09 f0cab280…, the four Execution/Invocation prerequisite hashes (699-706), the ten frozen source hashes (710-722) and the Reviewer registration/schema hashes; those rest on the shard packets, which reported them as matching.

Both shard packets were treated as evidence and re-checked against this exact candidate. All five distinct findings they raised are absent here: the lease-owned RuntimeReleaseRegistry is now the first input element of run_registered_inline_module_evaluation with its pass-through and same-object rule (145, 563-565); the architecture expectation says 'six strings' and 'all six errors' consistently (603, 611); the step-9 gate slice lists deterministic *_validation/*_classification tests declared unable to produce transport support (342, 445, 588-589); the Reviewer binding names registration schema_version runtime_module_registration_v2 with @v4 input/output schema refs (551-552); and conformance_architecture_validation.py is in the frozen source table (716). The code-truth shard's own stated subject hash (6efd74ef…) differs from the supplied a7a6c767…, indicating it reviewed an earlier revision.

The six exact architecture error strings (603-607), including `Runtime dependency debt exceeds its high-water mark`, could not be confirmed against the emitting validator; the code-truth shard recorded the same limit and noted a similarly-worded migration-debt message in the portion it saw. The candidate pins that producer by ref and SHA-256 (716) and binds the tuple to one named test (608-610), so the string set is checkable by its owner at implementation time.

Document anchors were not resolved: `#step-6-verification-code-design`, `#execution-inline-evaluation-helper`, `#8-public-interface-and-effects`, `#91-error-contract`, `#13-completion-failure-and-recovery`, `#10-completion-failure-and-recovery`, `#9-t2-delegation-map` and `#standalone_conformance_finalize`.

Non-defect observation recorded for transparency: line 582 writes 'engineering_change_reviewer@v4 Module' as shorthand, while the version label is anchored at 551-552 only on the input/output schema refs and immutable Module/Profile/Variant refs are explicitly left to step 11 (553-555). The test-governing facts are the enumerated registration fields plus the frozen registration hash, so this was judged wording, not a contract defect, and no change is required.

Later-step work was treated as correctly deferred and was not required of this basis: step 11 binding resolution, step 12 live registered Reviewer evidence and exact-commit Engineering Review, step 7/10 public manifest and package parity, and the canonical Example successor.
prose_review: 散文部分与 YAML 合同一致，未引入第二套语义。T2 11 的核心含义被逐项保留而非改写：三态 case result 与独立的 supported/unsupported 判定分离（341、519-521、605），not_run、failed 与 unsupported 三者互不改写且各有触发条件（190-192、218-220、570-572），无“他项通过故本项通过”的传播（309 no_result_propagation），focused 完成不得推出 full completion 且 complete 不得省略 Example、required gate decision、exact 05 result 或 required transports（604、624）。§4.7 的资源与证据边界被具体化为可执行规则：默认临时资源、显式 test namespace、按 owner_run_id 与活对象身份围栏的清理、清理失败照实保留、无显式 binding 即 local_only（127-128、137-138、555-564、576-579）。§4.8 的 Reviewer 边界被完整落实：静态闭包不触发 provider，unsupported 必须在进入 provider 前且调用计数为零，进入后失败一律 failed，合法 non_pass 可证明 transport（566-572、586-587）。叙述的诚实度高于一般水平：现有 21 passed 被明确排除为本次证据（707-709），现有架构失败被声明为计划内、保持可见且不得用 allowlist 或 shim 提前变绿（600-612、634），package conformance 无代码生产者一事被直书并交给 step 7/10（503-509）。文中未出现为解释作者历史而保留的实现残留，“Author self-check”一节自我限定为 author evidence only（748-749），“Scope and qualification”一节明确本文既不发起也不记录批准（733-739）。整体散文服务于合同解释与失败保守性，未构建投机性框架，可以作为后续 ChangeSetManifest 比对的稳定基线。
